verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are only partly evidenced: `npx convex import` loads data from a file into a deployment in bulk, and because queries and mutations are TypeScript functions running in an ACID-transactional database, a function invoked via `npx convex run` could plausibly loop over many documents. Neither multi-document updates or deletes nor batch limits are explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit bulk update/delete APIs or docs, documented batch/transaction size limits, MCP-tool bulk operations for agents, hands-on or independent corroboration.
